name: open-science-skills
description: Claude Code skills for experimental social science methodology, computational text analysis, manuscript QA, and transparent reporting

plugins.name: oss
plugins.description: Open Science Skills — 38 skills for experimental social science: research-repository scaffolding and auditing around a sources/ knowledge base (research-repo), decision-map research planning (research-wayfinder) and a single-sitting research interview for ideas, designs, and drafts (research-grill), conjoint design / cleaning / diagnostics, survey design, list experiments, cross-national design, live Qualtrics operations and pre-fielding audit (qualtrics-ops), fielded-data audit, topic modeling, LLM text classification with resumable batch runs, a three-phase VLM-OCR pipeline (evaluate, run, clean), independent model-council voting and inter-rater agreement, a deliberative GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 model committee chaired by a premier model that is never a member (Fable 5.1 by default, Astra via /model-committee-astra), an advisor consult that escalates a working model's decision point to Fable 5.1, LLM calibration via token logprobs, citation checking, source-claim fact-checking, literature-review evidence mapping, figure and table design, house-style LaTeX formatting (paper-tex), figure/table auditing, replication-package scaffolding and FAIR audit, hypothesis building, narrative building, pre-registration writing, methods reporting, creative divergence with an optional Codex mode (diverge), pre-submission review with an optional cross-model mode (paper-review-lite), presubmit, journal-review, author-side referee-response letters, a lead-detecting multi-model orchestration workflow (orchestrate, with fable-orchestrate and opus-orchestrate aliases), and full-peer-session spawning in git worktrees and terminal panes via herdr, tmux, or claude background agents (spawn). All skills are available as /oss:skill-name slash commands; every pre-2.25 name still resolves as an alias. Eleven core skills auto-trigger from context; the other 27 are on-demand and cost nothing in a session until invoked by name.
